gloss: life-threatening; to be a matter of life and death

definitions.gloss: life-threatening; to be a matter of life and death
definitions.explanation: Describes a situation, condition, or action that could result in death. Used to emphasize the extreme seriousness of a danger.

examples.japanese: {命|いのち}に{関|かか}わる⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
⟦{熱中症|ねっちゅうしょう}→熱中症：08330_necchuushou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{命|いのち}に{関|かか}わること⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。

⟦{放置|ほうち}すれば→放置する：25382_houchisuru⟧{命|いのち}に{関|かか}わる⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めて→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: It is an illness that can be fatal if left untreated, so please begin treatment immediately.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
Functions as a verb phrase. Can modify nouns with the plain form: {命|いのち}に{関|かか}わる⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧ (a life-threatening issue). The verb ⟦{関|かか}わる→関わる：03020_kakawaru⟧ conjugates as a godan verb.
- {命|いのち}に{関|かか}わる + noun (a life-threatening ~)
- {命|いのち}に{関|かか}わること⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (it can even be life-threatening)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {命|いのち}に{関|かか}わる⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧ (a life-threatening accident)
- {命|いのち}に{関|かか}わる⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧ (a life-threatening illness)
- {命|いのち}に{関|かか}わる⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧ (a matter of life and death)
